examples.en: The small fishing boats stayed safe in the harbor.
examples.zh: 小渔船安全地停在港口里。

examples.en: The cat is sleeping underneath the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 猫正睡在厨房桌子的下面。

examples.en: She applied for a visa at the American embassy.
examples.zh: 她在美国大使馆申请了签证。

examples.en: The preacher gave a long sermon on Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 那位牧师在周日早上做了一场很长的讲道。

examples.en: The room was too dim to read my book.
examples.zh: 房间太暗了，没法读我的书。

examples.en: The nurse gave the boy an injection in his arm.
examples.zh: 护士在男孩的手臂上打了一针。

examples.en: Her facial expression showed that she was surprised.
examples.zh: 她的面部表情显示出她很惊讶。

examples.en: Workers picked coffee beans on the large plantation.
examples.zh: 工人们在那座大种植园里采摘咖啡豆。

examples.en: His daily routine is simple and very predictable.
examples.zh: 他的日常生活很简单，非常容易预料。

examples.en: We watched the beautiful sunset over the sea.
examples.zh: 我们欣赏着海面上美丽的日落。

examples.en: I presume you have already finished your homework.
examples.zh: 我猜你已经做完作业了。

examples.en: Eating an excess of sugar is bad for your health.
examples.zh: 摄入过量的糖对你的健康有害。

examples.en: She is a strong proponent of free education.
examples.zh: 她是免费教育的坚定支持者。

examples.en: Every constituent has the right to vote in the election.
examples.zh: 每个选民都有权在选举中投票。

examples.en: Many Vietnamese people enjoy eating fresh noodle soup.
examples.zh: 许多越南人喜欢吃新鲜的米粉汤。

examples.en: My grandmother keeps a beautiful antique clock at home.
examples.zh: 我奶奶家里有一座漂亮的古董钟。

examples.en: The farmer milks his cows at the dairy every morning.
examples.zh: 农夫每天早上在乳牛场给奶牛挤奶。

examples.en: The gardener waters the flowers every morning.
examples.zh: 园丁每天早上给花浇水。

examples.en: He works for a Saudi oil company in the desert.
examples.zh: 他在沙漠里为一家沙特石油公司工作。

examples.en: We must protect children from online manipulation.
examples.zh: 我们必须保护孩子免受网络操纵。

examples.en: The speaker's wit made the whole audience laugh.
examples.zh: 演讲者的机智让全场观众都笑了。

examples.en: The children learned to skate on the frozen lake.
examples.zh: 孩子们在结冰的湖面上学会了滑冰。

examples.en: We had a fabulous holiday by the sea last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天我们在海边度过了一个极好的假期。

examples.en: Many people questioned the legitimacy of the new law.
examples.zh: 许多人质疑这项新法律的合法性。

examples.en: Turn left at the next intersection to reach the bank.
examples.zh: 在下一个十字路口左转就能到银行。

examples.en: He shouted a curse when he hit his thumb.
examples.zh: 他砸到拇指时骂了一句脏话。

examples.en: The manager handed in his resignation last week.
examples.zh: 经理上周递交了他的辞职信。

examples.en: The two countries are culturally very different.
examples.zh: 这两个国家在文化上有很大的差异。

examples.en: "Can I help you, ma'am?" the waiter asked politely.
examples.zh: “需要帮忙吗，女士？”服务员礼貌地问道。

examples.en: After years of fighting, the brothers reached a reconciliation.
examples.zh: 争吵多年之后，两兄弟终于和解了。

examples.en: Helping the old man cross the street was a kind deed.
examples.zh: 帮老人过马路是一件善举。

examples.en: The accident caused some hearing impairment in his left ear.
examples.zh: 那次事故造成他左耳有些听力损伤。

examples.en: She felt miserable after failing the important exam.
examples.zh: 在重要考试不及格后，她感到很痛苦。

examples.en: The factory bought new machinery to make cars faster.
examples.zh: 工厂买了新机器以便更快地生产汽车。

examples.en: The children were lively and full of energy.
examples.zh: 孩子们活泼好动，充满活力。

examples.en: Please erase the wrong answer and write it again.
examples.zh: 请把错误的答案擦掉，重新写一遍。

examples.en: We waited for our flight at the airport terminal.
examples.zh: 我们在机场航站楼等候我们的航班。

examples.en: He likes to shave his beard every morning.
examples.zh: 他喜欢每天早上刮胡子。

examples.en: Your question is irrelevant to today's topic.
examples.zh: 你的问题和今天的话题无关。

examples.en: It was foolish of him to lend so much money.
examples.zh: 他借出这么多钱，真是太愚蠢了。

examples.en: The old knight wore heavy armor in the battle.
examples.zh: 那位老骑士在战斗中穿着沉重的盔甲。

examples.en: She folded her clothes neatly and put them away.
examples.zh: 她把衣服整齐地叠好收了起来。

examples.en: His mistake was caused by ignorance, not by laziness.
examples.zh: 他的错误是由于无知，而不是懒惰。

examples.en: Many rare birds live in this protected wetland.
examples.zh: 许多稀有鸟类生活在这片受保护的湿地里。

examples.en: The skier raced quickly down the snowy mountain.
examples.zh: 那名滑雪者飞快地冲下了雪山。

examples.en: The Reverend Smith welcomed everyone to the church.
examples.zh: 史密斯牧师欢迎大家来到教堂。

examples.en: The children are playing happily on the playground.
examples.zh: 孩子们正在操场上开心地玩耍。

examples.en: Her face turned red with embarrassment.
examples.zh: 她窘迫得满脸通红。

examples.en: He is only an amateur, but he plays the piano well.
examples.zh: 他只是个业余爱好者，但钢琴弹得很好。

examples.en: Scientists study the cellular structure of plants.
examples.zh: 科学家研究植物的细胞结构。

examples.en: She is a competent teacher who explains things clearly.
examples.zh: 她是一位能干的老师，讲解得很清楚。

examples.en: Primitive people made tools out of stone and wood.
examples.zh: 原始人用石头和木头制作工具。

examples.en: We drank tea on the balcony in the warm sun.
examples.zh: 我们在暖和的阳光下在阳台上喝茶。

examples.en: He wiped the sweat from his brow with a towel.
examples.zh: 他用毛巾擦去额头上的汗水。

examples.en: Muslims gather at the mosque to pray on Fridays.
examples.zh: 穆斯林每逢周五聚集到清真寺祈祷。

examples.en: The teacher drew a simple linear graph on the board.
examples.zh: 老师在黑板上画了一个简单的线性图。

examples.en: The school is famous for its academic excellence.
examples.zh: 这所学校以其卓越的学术成就而闻名。

examples.en: We should recycle paper and glass to protect nature.
examples.zh: 我们应该回收纸张和玻璃来保护自然。

examples.en: The golfer finished the hole right on par.
examples.zh: 那位高尔夫球手刚好以标准杆完成了这个洞。

examples.en: People come to this church for worship every Sunday.
examples.zh: 人们每个星期天都来这座教堂做礼拜。

examples.en: Smoking is very harmful to your health.
examples.zh: 吸烟对你的健康非常有害。

examples.en: A tiny ant carried the crumb back to its nest.
examples.zh: 一只小蚂蚁把面包屑搬回了它的巢里。

examples.en: Meeting my old friend there was a happy coincidence.
examples.zh: 在那里遇到我的老朋友是个愉快的巧合。

examples.en: She felt deep resentment toward her unfair boss.
examples.zh: 她对不公平的老板心怀深深的怨恨。

examples.en: We must reduce our dependence on foreign oil.
examples.zh: 我们必须减少对外国石油的依赖。

examples.en: Pink is often seen as a feminine color.
examples.zh: 粉红色常被视为一种女性化的颜色。

examples.en: There is no justification for treating people so badly.
examples.zh: 如此恶劣地对待别人是没有任何正当理由的。

examples.en: College tuition has become very expensive these days.
examples.zh: 如今大学学费已经变得非常昂贵。

examples.en: The storm was so destructive that many houses fell.
examples.zh: 那场风暴破坏性极大，许多房屋都倒塌了。

examples.en: The new rule needs governmental approval first.
examples.zh: 这项新规定需要先得到政府的批准。

examples.en: Learning a language well requires plenty of repetition.
examples.zh: 学好一门语言需要大量的重复。

examples.en: She found a niche selling handmade jewelry online.
examples.zh: 她在网上售卖手工首饰找到了一个适合自己的位置。

examples.en: This small restaurant offers tasty and inexpensive meals.
examples.zh: 这家小餐馆提供美味又便宜的饭菜。

examples.en: The children played football in the school courtyard.
examples.zh: 孩子们在学校的庭院里踢足球。

examples.en: The company paid each shareholder a small dividend.
examples.zh: 公司向每位股东支付了一小笔股利。

examples.en: Loud thunder can terrify many small children.
examples.zh: 巨大的雷声会吓坏许多小孩子。

examples.en: The teacher asked me to revise my essay carefully.
examples.zh: 老师让我仔细修改我的文章。

examples.en: The tree's brown bark felt rough under my hand.
examples.zh: 那棵树褐色的树皮在我手下摸起来很粗糙。

examples.en: Stories about space travel fascinate young children.
examples.zh: 关于太空旅行的故事让小孩子们着迷。

examples.en: He felt a sharp stab of pain in his back.
examples.zh: 他感到背部一阵剧烈的刺痛。

examples.en: We used a generator for power during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨期间我们用发电机供电。

examples.en: We met for coffee at a small cafe downtown.
examples.zh: 我们在市中心一家小咖啡馆见面喝咖啡。

examples.en: The newspaper spread propaganda to support the war.
examples.zh: 那份报纸散布宣传以支持这场战争。

examples.en: The two roads run parallel to each other.
examples.zh: 这两条路彼此平行。

examples.en: These recent events underscore the need for change.
examples.zh: 最近的这些事件强调了变革的必要性。

examples.en: The team worked hard to formulate a clear plan.
examples.zh: 团队努力制定了一个清晰的计划。

examples.en: The old castle stands on a hill above the river.
examples.zh: 那座古老的城堡矗立在河上方的山丘上。

examples.en: He used a wooden stick to prop up the broken shelf.
examples.zh: 他用一根木棍把坏掉的架子支撑起来。

examples.en: I heated the soup in the microwave for two minutes.
examples.zh: 我把汤放进微波炉加热了两分钟。

examples.en: The incidence of flu rises every cold winter.
examples.zh: 每到寒冷的冬天，流感的发生率就会上升。

examples.en: Technically, this answer is correct, but it sounds odd.
examples.zh: 从技术上讲，这个答案是对的，但听起来很奇怪。

examples.en: He worked hard to fulfil his promise to his parents.
examples.zh: 他努力工作以履行对父母的承诺。

examples.en: The corrupt official took money from many people.
examples.zh: 那个腐败的官员从许多人手里收受钱财。

examples.en: The scientist studied a leaf specimen under the microscope.
examples.zh: 科学家在显微镜下研究一片叶子标本。

examples.en: The doctor gave the patient a thorough examination.
examples.zh: 医生给病人做了一次彻底的检查。

examples.en: Thick clouds began to obscure the bright moon.
examples.zh: 厚厚的云层开始遮住明亮的月亮。

examples.en: Her face looked wan after the long illness.
examples.zh: 久病之后，她的脸色看起来很苍白。

examples.en: The young monk lived quietly in the mountain temple.
examples.zh: 那位年轻的僧侣安静地住在山中的寺庙里。

examples.en: The fireworks were a wonderful spectacle to watch.
examples.zh: 那场烟花是一道精彩的景象，值得观赏。

examples.en: Riding the roller coaster gave me a real thrill.
examples.zh: 坐过山车让我感到一阵真正的刺激。

examples.en: Heroin is a dangerous drug that destroys many lives.
examples.zh: 海洛因是一种危险的毒品，毁掉了许多人的生活。

examples.en: She has a positive outlook on life despite her troubles.
examples.zh: 尽管遇到麻烦，她对生活仍持积极的态度。

examples.en: The class studied the reproductive system of flowers.
examples.zh: 这节课学习了花的生殖系统。

examples.en: He missed school after a bad bout of the flu.
examples.zh: 一场严重的流感发作后，他缺了课。

examples.en: She carried her laptop to the library to study.
examples.zh: 她带着笔记本电脑去图书馆学习。

examples.en: Swimming is my favorite form of recreation.
examples.zh: 游泳是我最喜欢的消遣方式。

examples.en: The new office has a comfortable working setup.
examples.zh: 新办公室有一套舒适的办公布置。

examples.en: Good drivers usually have strong spatial awareness.
examples.zh: 优秀的司机通常都有很强的空间意识。

examples.en: The dog gave the food a careful sniff before eating.
examples.zh: 狗在吃食物之前小心地嗅了一下。

examples.en: We organized a beach cleanup last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末我们组织了一次海滩清扫活动。

examples.en: The students learned how to add a simple matrix.
examples.zh: 学生们学习了如何对一个简单的矩阵做加法。

examples.en: My printer ran out of ink during the meeting.
examples.zh: 开会期间我的打印机没墨了。

examples.en: The plane sped down the runway and took off.
examples.zh: 飞机沿着跑道加速然后起飞了。

examples.en: The child ate an ice cream cone in the park.
examples.zh: 那个孩子在公园里吃了一个甜筒冰淇淋。

examples.en: We try to buy vegetables grown locally.
examples.zh: 我们尽量购买本地种植的蔬菜。

examples.en: We took a slow stroll along the river after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后我们沿着河边慢慢散步。

examples.en: Air is mostly made up of nitrogen and oxygen.
examples.zh: 空气主要由氮气和氧气组成。

examples.en: Trust is an integral part of any good friendship.
examples.zh: 信任是任何良好友谊不可或缺的一部分。

examples.en: After the meeting, they returned to their respective offices.
examples.zh: 会议结束后，他们各自回到自己的办公室。

examples.en: The water in the lake was clear and transparent.
examples.zh: 湖里的水清澈透明。

examples.en: The coach announced the team's lineup for the game.
examples.zh: 教练宣布了球队这场比赛的阵容。

examples.en: Open the windows to let fresh air circulate.
examples.zh: 打开窗户让新鲜空气流通。

examples.en: Scientists use classification to group different animals.
examples.zh: 科学家用分类法来给不同的动物归类。

examples.en: We will endeavor to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 我们将努力按时完成这个项目。

examples.en: The company wants to maximize its yearly profits.
examples.zh: 公司想要使年利润最大化。

examples.en: My advisor helped me choose the right courses.
examples.zh: 我的指导老师帮我选了合适的课程。

examples.en: Please read the first paragraph of the story aloud.
examples.zh: 请大声朗读故事的第一段。

examples.en: The news showed footage of the flooded streets.
examples.zh: 新闻播放了被淹街道的镜头。

examples.en: His excuse for being late sounded completely absurd.
examples.zh: 他迟到的借口听起来完全荒谬。

examples.en: She resisted the temptation to eat another cake.
examples.zh: 她忍住了再吃一块蛋糕的诱惑。

examples.en: The city gets its drinking water from this reservoir.
examples.zh: 这座城市的饮用水来自这个水库。

examples.en: A tiger has orange fur with black stripes.
examples.zh: 老虎有着橙色的皮毛和黑色的条纹。

examples.en: The strap on my bag broke while I was walking.
examples.zh: 我走路时包上的带子断了。

examples.en: The family enjoyed a huge feast on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 一家人在除夕夜享用了一顿丰盛的宴席。

examples.en: I felt nervous walking through the unfamiliar city.
examples.zh: 走在这个陌生的城市里，我感到很紧张。

examples.en: The conductor raised his baton and the music began.
examples.zh: 指挥举起指挥棒，音乐便开始了。

examples.en: The teacher used a simple analogy to explain the idea.
examples.zh: 老师用一个简单的类比来解释这个观点。

examples.en: Every inhabitant of the village knows each other well.
examples.zh: 村里的每个居民彼此都很熟悉。

examples.en: The toddler took her first steps across the room.
examples.zh: 那个幼儿迈出了她穿过房间的第一步。

examples.en: The company put its new logo on every product.
examples.zh: 公司把它的新标志印在了每件产品上。

examples.en: The rain began to intensify as the night went on.
examples.zh: 随着夜色加深，雨势开始加强。

examples.en: The ball flew through the air in a high arc.
examples.zh: 球以一道高高的弧线飞过空中。

examples.en: The tall trees sway gently in the evening wind.
examples.zh: 高大的树木在晚风中轻轻摇摆。

examples.en: I need to upgrade my phone to a newer model.
examples.zh: 我需要把手机升级到更新的型号。

examples.en: The postwar years brought rapid growth to the city.
examples.zh: 战后的那些年给这座城市带来了快速发展。

examples.en: Heavy rain caused serious erosion of the hillside.
examples.zh: 大雨造成了山坡严重的侵蚀。

examples.en: Her talent was manifest from a very young age.
examples.zh: 她的才华从很小的时候就显露无遗。

examples.en: As a sophomore, she joined the college debate team.
examples.zh: 作为大二学生，她加入了学院的辩论队。

examples.en: His refusal to help surprised all of us.
examples.zh: 他拒绝帮忙让我们所有人都感到意外。

examples.en: The park has many recreational activities for families.
examples.zh: 这个公园为家庭提供了许多娱乐活动。

examples.en: A sudden flush of red appeared on her cheeks.
examples.zh: 她的脸颊上突然泛起一阵红晕。

examples.en: The dog began to lick my hand happily.
examples.zh: 那只狗开心地舔起了我的手。

examples.en: Please align the chairs neatly along the wall.
examples.zh: 请把椅子沿墙整齐地排成一行。

examples.en: She was unaware of the danger behind her.
examples.zh: 她没有察觉到身后的危险。

examples.en: The town is predominantly made up of young families.
examples.zh: 这个小镇主要由年轻的家庭构成。

examples.en: The mighty river flowed quickly through the valley.
examples.zh: 那条强大的河流飞快地穿过山谷。

examples.en: I felt like an idiot for forgetting her name.
examples.zh: 忘了她的名字，我觉得自己像个白痴。

examples.en: The trial was held at the old city courthouse.
examples.zh: 审判在那座古老的市法院里举行。

examples.en: The store returned the phone because of a defect.
examples.zh: 因为有一处缺陷，商店退掉了那部手机。

examples.en: Beauty is subjective and differs from person to person.
examples.zh: 美是主观的，因人而异。

examples.en: The hotel is cheap, and additionally, it serves free breakfast.
examples.zh: 这家酒店很便宜，此外还提供免费早餐。

examples.en: The accountant checks the company's money every month.
examples.zh: 会计师每个月都核对公司的账目。

examples.en: His brother joined the navy after finishing school.
examples.zh: 他哥哥毕业后加入了海军。

examples.en: Make sure the soup is sufficiently hot before serving.
examples.zh: 上菜前要确保汤足够热。

examples.en: The storm showed the vulnerability of the old bridge.
examples.zh: 这场风暴暴露了那座旧桥的脆弱性。

examples.en: Turn the valve to stop the water from flowing.
examples.zh: 拧动阀门以阻止水流动。

examples.en: An owl hunts for mice quietly at night.
examples.zh: 猫头鹰在夜里悄悄地捕捉老鼠。

examples.en: The teacher treated all students with fairness.
examples.zh: 老师公正地对待所有的学生。

examples.en: The store decided to slash prices before the holiday.
examples.zh: 商店决定在假期前大幅削减价格。

examples.en: Each diner at the table ordered a different dish.
examples.zh: 桌上的每位用餐者都点了不同的菜。

examples.en: I saw an advertisement for new shoes on television.
examples.zh: 我在电视上看到了一则新鞋的广告。

examples.en: Chop the onions finely before adding them to the pan.
examples.zh: 把洋葱切碎，然后再放进锅里。

examples.en: Hundreds of people signed the petition to save the park.
examples.zh: 数百人在请愿书上签名以保护这座公园。

examples.en: They kept up a long correspondence through letters.
examples.zh: 他们通过信件保持了长期的通信往来。

examples.en: The doctor said an artery near his heart was blocked.
examples.zh: 医生说他心脏附近的一条动脉堵塞了。

examples.en: I could only hear static on the old radio.
examples.zh: 我在那台旧收音机里只能听到静电干扰声。

examples.en: The museum curator showed us the ancient paintings.
examples.zh: 博物馆馆长向我们展示了那些古老的画作。

examples.en: The teacher made a small correction to my answer.
examples.zh: 老师对我的答案做了一处小小的更正。

examples.en: A thin mist covered the fields early in the morning.
examples.zh: 清晨，一层薄雾笼罩着田野。

examples.en: The apple grower sells fresh fruit at the market.
examples.zh: 那位苹果种植者在市场上卖新鲜水果。

examples.en: Stop talking nonsense and tell me the truth.
examples.zh: 别说废话了，告诉我真相。

examples.en: Even after winning, he stayed humble and kind.
examples.zh: 即使获胜之后，他依然谦逊而友善。

examples.en: We watched a famous musical on Broadway in New York.
examples.zh: 我们在纽约的百老汇看了一场著名的音乐剧。

examples.en: She likes to chew gum while doing her homework.
examples.zh: 她喜欢一边做作业一边嚼口香糖。

examples.en: The test results gave us a baseline for comparison.
examples.zh: 测试结果为我们提供了一个用于比较的基准。

examples.en: The local fishery provides jobs for many villagers.
examples.zh: 当地的渔业为许多村民提供了工作。

examples.en: She spent a whole year writing her master's thesis.
examples.zh: 她花了整整一年写她的硕士论文。

examples.en: The video had clear pictures but poor audio.
examples.zh: 这段视频画面清晰，但音频很差。

examples.en: The students learned to find the coefficient in the equation.
examples.zh: 学生们学习了如何找出方程中的系数。

examples.en: Scientists study cosmic rays coming from outer space.
examples.zh: 科学家研究来自外太空的宇宙射线。

examples.en: She sat by the window to ponder her difficult choice.
examples.zh: 她坐在窗边思考她那个艰难的选择。

examples.en: Adding too many rules will only complicate the game.
examples.zh: 增加太多规则只会让游戏变得复杂。

examples.en: The quiet forest felt like a peaceful sanctuary.
examples.zh: 那片宁静的森林感觉就像一个平和的避难所。

examples.en: Many leaders began to denounce the cruel new law.
examples.zh: 许多领导人开始谴责这项残酷的新法律。

examples.en: He sat on a tall stool at the kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 他坐在厨房柜台旁的一张高凳子上。

examples.en: We waited in the airport lounge before our flight.
examples.zh: 在登机前，我们在机场休息室等候。

examples.en: She gave a credible reason for being late.
examples.zh: 她给出了一个可信的迟到理由。

examples.en: I made a sandwich with tuna and fresh bread.
examples.zh: 我用金枪鱼和新鲜面包做了一个三明治。

examples.en: The essay needs one more revision before I hand it in.
examples.zh: 这篇文章在我上交之前还需要再修改一次。

examples.en: We left early to travel while there was still daylight.
examples.zh: 我们早早出发，趁着还有日光赶路。
